title: Choosing nearby, farther away, or identifiable
summary: Choose a singular demonstrative from the speaker-listener situation.
objectives: Use tämä for a nearby referent.
Use tuo for a farther jointly visible referent.
Use se when the listener or context identifies the referent.

sections.title: See the pattern
paragraphs: The English word “that” does not by itself choose a Finnish demonstrative.
Finnish tracks how the speaker and listener can identify the referent.

sections.title: Use one clear decision
paragraphs: Read the scene before choosing: close suggests tämä, farther and visible suggests tuo, and listener-known suggests se.
The exact context matters more than a one-word English translation.
keyPoints: do not guess from English alone

examples.english: That one over there is a car.

commonMistakes: Do not choose tuo merely because the English sentence says “that.”
Do not use tämä for an item described as farther away.
Do not use se when the scene explicitly introduces a newly pointed-out nearby item.

practiceExercises.prompt: Optional practice: At a study desk. Translate “Se on talo.” into English. The referent is already identifiable from the conversation.
practiceExercises.explanation: Se is the singular demonstrative for a situation where the listener can identify the referent.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: demonstrative subject: identifies the referent + linking verb + identity information

practiceExercises.instruction: Put the words in the correct order.
practiceExercises.prompt: Optional practice: Build “This is a bag.” At a school entrance. The referent is close to the speaker. Use laukku (“a bag”) and on (“is”).
practiceExercises.explanation: Tämä is the singular demonstrative for a situation where the referent is close to the speaker.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: demonstrative subject: identifies the referent + linking verb + identity information

practiceExercises.prompt: Optional practice: Choose the sentence that means “That one over there is a bag.” While sorting objects. The referent is farther away and visible. Use laukku (“a bag”) and on (“is”).
practiceExercises.explanation: Tuo is the singular demonstrative for a situation where the referent is farther away and visible.

sentenceExplanation.translation: That one over there is a bag.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: demonstrative subject: identifies the referent + linking verb + identity information

Correct. Tuo is the singular demonstrative for a situation where the referent is farther away and visible.
“Tämä” is a singular nominative form for a referent near the speaker; use “Tuo”, a singular nominative form for a farther, jointly visible referent.
“Se” is a singular nominative form for an already identifiable non-human referent; use “Tuo”, a singular nominative form for a farther, jointly visible referent.
